votes.title: Flock System / License Plate Reader: require Police status updates, legal review of ordinance framework, and revisit within 90 days
votes.summary: After a Committee of the Whole public hearing on the Flock System / License Plate Reader (Police Chief Christopher Kelly in favor; 12 residents recorded in opposition), Councilor Avery, seconded by Councilor Dr. Meaney, moved that over the next 90 days the city receive regular status updates from the Police Department on how the system is used, compliance with safeguards, and any misuse or unauthorized access; that within 45 days the Legal Department provide legal options and next steps, including a framework for an ordinance addressing oversight, enforceable privacy protections, accountability for misuse, and the authority to prohibit the system's use; and that within 90 days the Council revisit the issue with community input and decide a path forward, scheduling a meeting for the first meeting in January. Motion carried; Committee of the Whole report accepted.
